title: $q$-Analogues of some supercongruences related to generalized Van Hamme-type supercongruences
summary: Recently, Jana and Kalita (Res. Number Theory $\textbf{8}~ (2022),$ Article $54$) obtained certain supercongruences motivated by some generalized Van Hamme type supercongruences, specifically for an integer $\ell \geq 2$ and an odd prime $p$ with $p \equiv -1 \pmod{\ell},$ \begin{align*} \displaystyle \sum_{n=0}^{\frac{p^v + 1}{\ell}} (-1)^n (2 \ell n - 1) (\ell^2 n^2 - \ell n + 1) \frac{(-\frac{1}{\ell})_n^3}{(1)_n^3} \equiv (-1)^{\frac{p^v + p + 2}{\ell}} p^{3v} \pmod{p^{3v+1}}, \end{align*} and \begin{align*} \displaystyle \sum_{n=0}^{\frac{p^v + 1}{\ell}} (2 \ell n - 1) (2 \ell^2 n^2 - 2…
